Application Data.NAME: SecureLock Solutions, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SecureLock Solutions, LLC provides comprehensive locksmith services, specializing in residential and commercial lock installation, repair, and key duplication. We prioritize customer security and satisfaction, ensuring all operations are conducted in alarmed and monitored premises. Our team utilizes state-of-the-art tools and technology to deliver efficient service while maintaining strict inventory control to mitigate theft risk. In addition, we offer small-group instructional locksmith courses, adhering to documented safety protocols. With over three years of established operations, we have built a reputation for reliability and professionalism in our community.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: SecureLock Mobile Services, LLC; 4567 Safe Street, Suite 300, Springfield, IL 62704-5678; Specializing in mobile locksmith services for residential and commercial clients.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2021, a burglary occurred at our secured premises, resulting in the theft of tools valued at $3,000. The claim was reported to local authorities, and the status is closed after receiving a reimbursement from our insurance provider. Additionally, on 11/10/2022, a minor incident involved an employee sustaining an injury while handling equipment, leading to a medical expense of $2,000. This claim is currently in process and pending resolution.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Standard security measures in place with 24/7 monitoring, alarm systems, and controlled access during operational hours. Additional inventory is secured within a locked safe vault during non-operational hours.
